user.title: Precision Plex
user.description: Select the Precision Plex controller to add to Home Assistant.

pair.title: Pair Precision Plex
pair.description:
Put your Precision Plex wall panel into Pair with Mobile mode before continuing.

On the wall panel:

Setup → Wireless → Pair with Mobile

When Pair with Mobile is active, the button turns green briefly. This pairing window only stays active for a few seconds.

While Home Assistant is trying to pair, keep pressing Pair with Mobile whenever the button returns to its normal color. It may take several attempts before pairing succeeds.

Once the button is green, check the box below and click Submit.

init.title: Precision Plex Maintenance
init.description:
Use this screen to repair Bluetooth pairing for an already configured Precision Plex controller.

This is useful if:

• Home Assistant was restored from backup
• The SD card or hardware was changed
• The Bluetooth adapter was changed
• Precision Plex entities are unavailable after a Bluetooth change
• The controller appears connected but telemetry is not updating

The re-pair tool will disconnect the current BLE session, clear the stored BlueZ Bluetooth device record, pair again, mark the controller trusted, and reload the integration.
